_: Трендовый набор из 20 кадров, собран 19.08.2026: персонаж с разных сторон, кадры разнообразны, лицо в каждом измеримо. Клетки прошли три круга критики (доктрина, разнообразие, узнаваемость), затем линтер lint_shotlist.py.

cells.label: Селфи со вспышкой в лифте
cells.function: Кадр, где она снимает себя сама: сегодняшний язык самопоказа и повод увидеть её в полный рост в тесной реальной коробке.
cells.framing: full-length mirror selfie, she stands squared to the glass with her weight on one leg, the phone held at her waist in the hand away from her face so her whole face stays clear, her reflection running from her shoes at the bottom edge to her head in the upper fifth of the frame
cells.gaze: her eyes meeting her reflection dead on, chin level
cells.wardrobe: a deep navy fine wool dress with a camel coat folded over her arm, pointed-toe stiletto pumps, small thin gold hoop earrings
cells.set: the mirrored lift of an apartment building, brushed steel walls, a scuffed floor, a set of keys hooked on one finger
cells.light: the on-camera phone flash firing straight into the mirror, a hot core of light beside her waist, hard shadow edges thrown behind her shoulders, the specular return of the flash landing on the brushed steel beside her while her reflected face keeps clean contrast, a warm ceiling bulb tinting the top edge of the mirror
cells.camera: phone camera look, 26mm-equivalent held at waist height and tipped a degree or two up, flash on the lens axis, focus on her reflected face, a slight tilt to the mirror frame
cells.notes: Телефон у пояса и в руке дальше от лица — лицо открыто целиком. Голова обязана попадать в верхнюю пятую часть кадра, иначе фигура уходит и мерить нечего. Пятно вспышки уводить на сталь рядом, отражённое лицо держит контраст.
cells.function_en: A woman photographing herself in a lift mirror, the flash blooming in the glass beside her, keys hooked on one finger.
cells.alt: Full-length mirror selfie in a lift, phone flash flaring beside her waist, navy wool dress with a camel coat over her arm
cells._size: 2.64, а не 2:3. Замерено 19.08 на T11, лестница 1.50/1.79/2.00/2.33/2.64 по три сида: на 1.50 и 1.79 кадр всё равно поясной, фигура целиком с обувью появляется от 2.33 и уверенно на 2.64. Прежние [1024,1536] проходили линтер и не работали.
cells.expression: her mouth closed and set, eyebrows a little raised as she checks her own reflection, the look cool and appraising

cells.label: Пролёт лестницы, свет экрана
cells.function: Самый сегодняшний источник света в наборе и прямая, исходящая версия её флирта: вечером на выходе из дома она смотрит первой.
cells.framing: close chest-up taken from one step below her, she lowers the phone to chest level and lifts her face to the lens, the screen tilted up at her from just under eye level and about thirty degrees to camera left, her hand staying below her collarbone, the banister rail crossing behind her shoulder
cells.gaze: a straight look into the lens with her chin up and held there, the look steady and openly interested
cells.wardrobe: a camel wool coat open over a wine-red silk shirt, a narrow gold bangle and a slim gold watch picking up the screen light
cells.set: the stairwell landing of an old apartment building late in the evening, a worn stone step, a bicycle chained to the banister
cells.light: her phone screen as the key from just under eye level and camera left, cool and close, the timed hall light two flights above dropping a faint warm ambient across her brow and hair so the top of her face keeps detail, the depth of the stairwell staying dark
cells.camera: 50mm at f/1.8 from one step below her, focus on the near eye
cells.notes: Экран чуть ниже линии глаз и на тридцать градусов вбок: строго снизу по центру выходит маска вместо лица. Слабый тёплый ambient сверху обязателен — на нём держатся лоб и брови. Подбородок вверх, взгляд прямой: это единственная клетка с исходящим флиртом.
cells.function_en: A woman on a dark stairwell landing lifting her face out of her phone's light and looking straight into the lens.
cells.alt: Woman on a dark stairwell landing lit by her phone screen from just below eye level, chin up, looking into the lens
cells.expression: caught mid-sentence into the phone with her mouth open on a word and one eyebrow lifted

cells.label: Дневной ветер на террасе
cells.function: Открытый воздух и движение: фигура целиком на высоте, ветер, дыхание и ровный направленный свет дня, без закатной драмы.
cells.framing: full-length standing frame, she moves along the railing with one hand trailing the rail and her weight going onto the front foot, hazy open sky above her, her figure filling the frame from her shoes at the bottom edge to her head in the upper fifth
cells.gaze: her eyes coming round to the lens as she turns into the wind
cells.wardrobe: an ivory silk shirt with the hem pulled loose at one side over warm grey wool trousers, pointed-toe stiletto pumps
cells.set: a rooftop terrace above low city roofs in the middle of the afternoon, a metal railing, one glass standing on the ledge behind her, laundry lines and aerials on the roofs below
cells.light: high hazy sun swung round to about forty-five degrees front-left, soft and directional across her face, the pale terrace floor returning a gentle fill into the shadow side so both eyes read, the milky sky behind her sitting quieter than her skin
cells.camera: 35mm at f/4 handheld from a step below her eye line, deep enough to hold her shoes and the railing sharp
cells.notes: Солнце спереди-слева под сорок пять градусов, дымка смягчает его: боковой рейк и закатный контровой гасят половину лица. Кадр держат ветер и шаг вдоль перил, а не длинная тень.
cells.function_en: A woman walking along a rooftop railing in the hazy afternoon wind, her shirt hem lifting, the city low behind her.
cells.alt: Full-length on a rooftop terrace in hazy afternoon light, she moves along the railing with the wind in her shirt
cells._size: 2.64, а не 2:3. Замерено 19.08 на T11, лестница 1.50/1.79/2.00/2.33/2.64 по три сида: на 1.50 и 1.79 кадр всё равно поясной, фигура целиком с обувью появляется от 2.33 и уверенно на 2.64. Прежние [1024,1536] проходили линтер и не работали.
cells.expression: her lips parted and her eyes narrowed against the wind, the beginnings of a smile at one corner only

cells.label: Первый свет на платформе
cells.function: Самый ранний час набора, но со светом с одного бока и с делом в руках: она уже в дороге, пока город ещё просыпается.
cells.framing: waist-up with the camera just below her eye line, she stands turned three-quarters to the lens with a paper cup of coffee held at chest level, the platform running away behind her past a lit departure board
cells.gaze: her eyes level with the lens, awake and steady
cells.wardrobe: a deep navy wool coat buttoned high with a heavy warm grey cashmere scarf wound at the neck
cells.set: the platform of a suburban station at first light in late autumn, mist lying over the tracks, a departure board glowing pale at the far end, a few other travellers small and soft far down the platform
cells.light: low early sun coming in from one side just over the tracks, a warm edge along her cheekbone and jaw with an honest open shadow on the other side of her face, the pale platform wall opposite lifting that shadow enough for both eyes to read, her breath catching the light as it drifts back past her hair
cells.camera: 105mm at f/2.8 from just below her eye line, focus locked on the near eye
cells.notes: Источник один и сбоку: тёплая грань по скуле, читаемая тень с другой стороны, отражение от стены напротив держит дальний глаз. Пар от дыхания идёт мимо лица, кофе в руках даёт делу опору.
cells.function_en: A woman waiting on a suburban platform at first light, a paper cup of coffee at her chest, low sun cutting warm along one cheekbone.
cells.alt: Waist-up portrait on a misty station platform at dawn, low side sun on one cheekbone, coffee cup held at her chest
cells.expression: a wide unguarded yawn caught halfway, eyes screwed shut and her chin lifting, the lines at her eyes at their deepest

cells.label: За верстаком у окна
cells.function: Единственный кадр о деле и умении: руки заняты работой, а свет — та самая боковая оконная схема с честным падением в тень, которой в наборе нет.
cells.framing: chest-up at a workshop bench, the camera looking down at her from about twenty degrees while she brings her face up to it, a steel rule held down on a sheet of mount board and a blade resting where she stopped cutting, finished frames stacked at her elbow
cells.gaze: her eyes coming up off the cut to the lens, level and easy, her hand staying on the rule
cells.wardrobe: a soft leather apron over an ivory silk shirt with the sleeves rolled back
cells.set: the back room of a small framing workshop in the late morning, a long bench under a tall side window, offcuts of mount board, sheets of glass leaning against the wall, a mug going cold at the far end
cells.light: the tall side window camera left as the single source, bright and directional on the near side of her face, the far cheek falling away into an honest deep shadow, the workshop behind her going dark, one bright line running along the cut edge of the mount board
cells.camera: 85mm at f/2.8 from standing height about twenty degrees above her eye line, focus held on her eyes
cells.notes: Падение в тень на дальней стороне лица обязано быть видно — на нём стоит вся схема. Взгляд поднимается от работы, а не от мысли; руки остаются на инструменте.
cells.function_en: A woman at a framing bench with a steel rule held down on mount board, one tall side window laying bright light across the near side of her face.
cells.alt: Woman at a workshop bench cutting mount board, bright side-window light on one cheek, deep shadow on the other
cells.expression: concentrating hard on the cut, brows drawn together and her lips pressed thin, entirely unaware of the camera

cells.label: После корта, в тени трибуны
cells.function: Тело сразу после нагрузки: дыхание, поза, рука на затылке — состояние, а не поза для камеры.
cells.framing: seated mid-shot from bench height just below her eye line, elbows on knees, one hand resting at the back of her neck, her face turned up toward the lens
cells.gaze: her eyes coming up to the lens with her breath still settling
cells.wardrobe: a deep navy sports top with a warm grey merino cardigan pulled on over it, the sleeves pushed up
cells.set: the shaded space under the stand beside an outdoor paddle tennis court in the late afternoon, a racket propped against her shin, a water bottle sweating on the bench slats, the sunlit blue court filling the wide opening in front of her
cells.light: open shade under the stand with the sunlit blue court in front of her working as one wide bright reflector, a clean even light coming up into her face and opening her eyes, the beams and depth of the stand behind her dropping away dark
cells.camera: 50mm at f/2 from bench height just below her eye line, the near eye holding the focus
cells.notes: Источник один — отражённый свет от освещённого корта спереди, ровный на всё лицо. Тёмная глубина трибуны за спиной оставляет лицо самым светлым в кадре.
cells.function_en: A woman just off the court sitting under the stand, breath still settling, one hand at the back of her neck, the bright blue court glowing in front of her.
cells.alt: Woman on a bench in the shade under a stand beside a paddle court, hand at the back of her neck, bright court light on her face
cells.expression: still catching her breath, mouth open, cheeks flushed and a tired grin coming up as she looks over

cells.label: Селфи на вытянутой руке
cells.function: Обиходное лицо: фронтальная камера с руки, близко и по-домашнему — такой её видят в переписке. Единственная клетка, где остаётся классическая полуулыбка с подбородком вниз.
cells.framing: arm's-length front-camera selfie held at eye level, her face centred in the frame and filling the middle, her extended forearm entering the bottom corner, a mild wide-angle stretch staying out at the edges
cells.gaze: eye contact into the lens held a beat longer than she meant, chin slightly down
cells.wardrobe: a camel cashmere sweater with an ivory silk collar showing at the neck, small thin gold hoop earrings
cells.set: a window seat on an intercity train, the seat back and a folded newspaper behind her, fields sliding past the glass in soft blur
cells.light: flat daylight through the train window from camera right, an even cool wash across her face, the carriage behind her falling away into soft shade
cells.camera: front phone camera at its 1x lens, about 28mm-equivalent, held at full arm's length at eye level, focus on her face, her features sitting in the centre of the field where the geometry stays true
cells.notes: Штатный 1x и уровень глаз: на сверхширокой фронталке нос и лоб растут, и косинус к эталону падает. Лицо держать в середине кадра — растяжение остаётся по краям.
cells.function_en: A woman on a train holding her phone out at arm's length, daylight from the window flat across her face.
cells.alt: Arm's-length front-camera selfie on a train, daylight from the window, a small half-smile into the lens
cells.expression: an open laugh with her head tipped back a little, eyes creased almost shut and her upper teeth showing

cells.label: Такси, зелёная вывеска
cells.function: Перегон между двумя точками вечера: одна густая краска с улицы держит всё лицо, вечер уже отработан.
cells.framing: chest-up from the seat beside her, her head turned three-quarters to the lens with her shoulder against the door, the driver's headrest and the seatbelt strap crossing the frame
cells.gaze: her attention resting just past the lens on the camera side, her thoughts still on the evening behind her
cells.wardrobe: a deep navy wool coat with the collar standing up on one side
cells.set: the back seat of a taxi held at a red light in the city, her phone face down on her knee, rain-beaded window glass beside her, a big lit pharmacy sign right outside
cells.light: the green pharmacy sign outside her window pouring one saturated colour across her whole face as the single source, the wet glass beside her returning the same green a couple of stops under so the far eye and the jawline keep detail, the cabin around her going flat black
cells.camera: 35mm at f/1.8 from the seat beside her, level with her face, the near eye carrying the focus
cells.notes: Один цвет на всё лицо и чёрный фон — вся схема; вторая температура сюда не заходит, деталь дальней стороне даёт отражение того же зелёного от мокрого стекла. Поворот головы не дальше трёх четвертей: ближнее ухо остаётся в кадре.
cells.function_en: A woman in the back of a taxi stopped at a light, one green sign outside the window colouring her whole face, the cabin black around her.
cells.alt: Woman in a taxi at night, a green pharmacy sign colouring her whole face, the cabin behind her black
cells.expression: her jaw set and her eyes flat with tiredness, looking out past the lens at the empty middle distance

cells.label: Супермаркет в десять вечера
cells.function: Самый честный свет набора: холодные потолочные лампы над бытовым поручением в конце дня.
cells.framing: chest-up, three-quarters to the lens, chin lifted a little so the strips fall on her brow and lids, a jar held at chest level as she reads the label entering the lower edge of the frame, her free hand resting at her collarbone
cells.gaze: her eyes coming off the small print toward the lens, half of her still on the label
cells.wardrobe: a deep navy cashmere coat over a soft warm grey house sweater
cells.set: the chilled aisle of a supermarket late in the evening, fridge doors and stacked packaging behind her, a small basket hooked over her forearm
cells.light: cold overhead fluorescent strips with the fridge cabinets throwing a pale vertical panel onto the near side of her face at eye height so the sockets stay open, the top-down fall leaving a faint shadow along her neck
cells.camera: 35mm at f/2.8 level with her face, focus on the near eye, the aisle running away behind her
cells.notes: Вертикальная панель от холодильных витрин на высоте глаз открывает глазницы под верхними лампами; подбородок чуть выше. Банка держится на уровне груди, ниже линии лица.
cells.function_en: A woman reading the label on a jar in a cold supermarket aisle late in the evening, overhead strips falling on her brow.
cells.alt: Woman reading a jar label in a supermarket aisle under cold overhead light, pale glow from the fridge cabinets on her face
cells.expression: her eyebrows drawn up in doubt as she reads the label, mouth pulled to one side

cells.label: Субботний рынок, расчёт
cells.function: Кадр с обменом и чужими руками: короткое деловое дело, где она распоряжается собой, деньгами и временем.
cells.framing: waist-up, turned three-quarters toward the counter with her face coming back to the lens, a folded note held out and the wrapped parcel already on the marble, the vendor's hands and the white counter edge soft in the foreground across the lower third and well below her chin
cells.gaze: her eyes coming straight back to the lens, chin level
cells.wardrobe: a warm grey wool coat with a wine-red silk scarf, a canvas bag on the shoulder
cells.set: a covered market on a Saturday, a cheese counter with wheels stacked pale on the marble, crates and hanging price tags behind
cells.light: daylight coming down from the market's high roof lights, soft and slightly top-down, the white counter and pale cheese wheels bouncing it back up into her eyes, the aisle behind her going dim and cool
cells.camera: 40mm at f/2.8 from just above her eye line, focus on her eyes, the foreground hands thrown soft
cells.notes: Руки продавца идут размыто и ниже подбородка. Отражение от белого прилавка снизу открывает глазницы под верхним светом. Взгляд ровный и деловой — полуулыбка остаётся другим клеткам.
cells.function_en: A woman paying at a market cheese counter, the vendor's hands soft in front of her, her eyes coming back level to the lens.
cells.alt: Woman paying at a covered market cheese counter, vendor's hands blurred in the foreground, her face turning back to the lens
cells.expression: caught mid-negotiation, speaking, one eyebrow up and her chin forward, half a smile underneath it

cells.label: Пятнистое утро, липовая аллея
cells.function: Единственный кадр, где она идёт: тело в шаге, пола пальто отстаёт, свет двигается вместе с ней, а мысль остаётся при ней.
cells.framing: medium-long from the knees up, she walks toward the lens caught mid-stride with her weight on one foot, her coat swinging open, the avenue running away behind her
cells.gaze: her eyes carried level down the avenue and just past the lens, working something out as she walks
cells.wardrobe: a warm grey cashmere coat swinging open over a camel knit
cells.set: a lime-tree avenue in a city park in spring, mid-morning, damp gravel underfoot, a runner far behind her out of focus
cells.light: sun coming through new leaves and dropping moving coins of light over her coat and shoulders, the patch of open shade she walks through wide enough to carry her whole head through the step, the sunlit gravel behind her glowing into round highlights
cells.camera: 85mm at f/2.8 level with her face, a fast shutter freezing the step with her face sharp, focus locked on her near eye as she walks in, the avenue compressed flat behind her
cells.notes: Ровная тень должна быть шире её головы на весь шаг, монеты света живут на пальто и плечах. Короткая выдержка обязательна — лицо резкое, движение читается по подолу.
cells.function_en: A woman mid-stride down a lime-tree avenue, coins of sunlight moving across her coat, her face inside one broad patch of open shade.
cells.alt: Woman walking toward the camera down a lime-tree avenue, dappled morning light across her coat, face in even shade
cells._size: 2.64, а не 2:3. Замерено 19.08 на T11, лестница 1.50/1.79/2.00/2.33/2.64 по три сида: на 1.50 и 1.79 кадр всё равно поясной, фигура целиком с обувью появляется от 2.33 и уверенно на 2.64. Прежние [1024,1536] проходили линтер и не работали.
cells.expression: squinting into the low sun with one eye narrower than the other and the bridge of her nose wrinkled

cells.label: Золотой час, ветер у воды
cells.function: Флирт пойманный, а не адресованный камере: она отвечает человеку рядом, и объективу улыбка достаётся вскользь.
cells.framing: waist-up medium, she sits slightly off-centre with open water behind her, one hand catching a strand of hair at her jaw with the fingers low on the cheek, the rest of her hair streaming back past her ear
cells.gaze: her eyes coming round to the lens as the wind turns her face
cells.wardrobe: an ivory silk shirt with the hem pulled loose at one side, moving in the wind
cells.set: a pale sand spit at the very end of a late-summer day, dune grass bending, flat bright water behind her, a folded jacket and two glasses on the sand beside her
cells.light: the low sun set well behind her shoulder camera right laying a warm rim along her hair and the top of her arm, the pale dry sand in front of her throwing a broad warm bounce that reads as the main light on the whole front of her face, a soft golden veil of flare kept in the far corner of the frame
cells.camera: 50mm at f/1.8 at eye level, the frame filled by her and the bright water behind her, focus on the near eye
cells.notes: Пряди летят по челюсти и мимо уха, глаза и переносица открыты; вуаль флера — в дальнем углу. Улыбка адресована собеседнику сбоку, лицо повёрнуто к камере на три четверти. Песок работает большим отражателем: перед лицом полная заливка, солнцу оставить волосы и плечо.
cells.function_en: A woman on a sand spit at the end of the day turning to smile at the person beside her, wind pulling her hair back, warm light off the sand filling her face.
cells.alt: Waist-up portrait on a sand spit at golden hour, wind pulling her hair back past her ear, warm bounce off the sand on her face
cells.expression: laughing with her eyes shut and one hand coming up toward her face, the wind taking her hair across her mouth

cells.label: Прачечная, поздний вечер
cells.function: Единственный кадр, где она занята скучным делом и снята в упор вспышкой: сегодняшний язык бытовой съёмки.
cells.framing: waist-up across a folding table, she is squared to it and lifts her face to the lens, a folded shirt still in both hands at table height, the row of machines running away behind her shoulder
cells.gaze: a level look straight into the lens
cells.wardrobe: a warm grey cashmere jumper with the sleeves pushed up, a narrow gold bangle and a slim gold watch
cells.set: a launderette late in the evening, a wall of front-loading machines with one drum still turning, a folding table under the window, a laundry bag slumped at the end of it
cells.light: the on-camera phone flash as the key, close and hard, throwing a crisp shadow of her shoulder onto the machines behind, the fluorescent ceiling tubes filling the room behind her in a cooler green-white so the depth stays lit while her face keeps the flash's own contrast
cells.camera: phone camera look, 26mm-equivalent at chest height, flash on the lens axis, focus on the near eye
cells.notes: Заменяет прежний «Дождь в упор», где дождя в кадре не было ни на одном сиде. Здесь место читается рядом машин и бельём в руках. Вспышка обязана бросать тень на машины — это доказательство, что свет в кадре, а не наложен.
cells.function_en: A woman folding laundry in a launderette late at night, lit head-on by a phone flash.
cells.alt: Waist-up in a launderette at night, phone flash lighting her face, a folded shirt in her hands and machines behind
cells.expression: the blank, emptied-out face of the end of a long day, lips slightly apart, eyes steady and unfocused

cells.label: Синий час, витрина
cells.function: Вечер, вынесенный на улицу: холодное небо после заката и тёплая витрина сходятся прямо на щеке, отражения в брусчатке.
cells.framing: three-quarter length from the knees up, she stands close to the glass with the street running away behind her, one hand turning her scarf up against the cold and a paper carrier bag hanging from the other
cells.gaze: her eyes settling on the lens for a moment, chin level
cells.wardrobe: a deep navy wool coat over a wine-red scarf
cells.set: a wet cobbled street in winter twenty minutes after sunset, a lit shopfront to one side, a bus passing behind her as a smear of warm light, standing reflections in the puddles
cells.light: deep blue open-sky ambient washing the whole scene and holding a couple of stops under the key so the far eye and cheek keep detail, the big lit shop window working as a soft warm panel on the near side of her face, the two temperatures meeting along the cheekbone, street lights behind rendering as round highlights
cells.camera: 35mm at f/2 level with her eyes, sharpest on her near eye, the background lights soft and round
cells.notes: Граница тёплого и холодного идёт по скуле — на ней кадр и стоит. Дальняя половина лица держит деталь, а не проваливается в синее. Руки заняты шарфом и пакетом: жест наружу, а не к себе.
cells.function_en: A woman on a wet cobbled street twenty minutes after sunset, a lit shop window warming one side of her face against the blue air.
cells.alt: Three-quarter length on a wet cobbled street at blue hour, warm shop window light on one cheek, hand turning her scarf up
cells._size: 2.64, а не 2:3. Замерено 19.08 на T11, лестница 1.50/1.79/2.00/2.33/2.64 по три сида: на 1.50 и 1.79 кадр всё равно поясной, фигура целиком с обувью появляется от 2.33 и уверенно на 2.64. Прежние [1024,1536] проходили линтер и не работали.
cells.expression: startled mid-turn, eyebrows high and mouth just opening, caught a half-second before she recognises who is calling

cells.label: Её рассмешили за столом
cells.function: Флирт как ответ: кто-то за столом сказал удачное, и она смеётся вслух — единственный настоящий смех набора, и единственный низкий широкий тёплый источник.
cells.framing: chest-up from standing height beside the table, she has come back in her chair with her shoulders open in a laugh, a wine glass still in her hand at the table edge, her face tipped up to the camera
cells.gaze: her face tipped up toward the lens
cells.wardrobe: a wine-red silk blouse under a warm grey fine wool jacket
cells.set: a long table at the end of a dinner party in a friend's dining room, plates pushed together, candles burnt low, the shoulders and hands of other guests at the edges
cells.light: the shaded table lamp beside her sitting just above her eye line as the key, the wide pale tablecloth in front of her returning a broad soft warmth up under her chin, catchlights sitting in both eyes, the room behind her dropping into warm dark
cells.camera: 50mm at f/2 from standing height about twenty-five degrees above her eye line, focus on her near eye, the table falling away soft
cells.notes: Смех открытый, с зубами, глаза остаются открытыми на камеру — на этом кадре набор перестаёт быть одной полуулыбкой. Источник низкий и широкий (скатерть), лампа рядом держит лоб и блики в глазах.
cells.function_en: A woman at a dinner table laughing out loud at something said across it, warm lamplight and a pale cloth throwing light up into her face.
cells.alt: Chest-up at a dinner table, a woman laughing openly into the camera, warm lamp light and a pale cloth lifting light into her face
cells.expression: mid-laugh with her head turned away and her eyes screwed shut, one shoulder coming up

cells.label: У парикмахера, в зеркале
cells.function: Место, где на себя смотрят дольше всего, и единственное зеркало набора кроме лифта.
cells.framing: chest-up seen in the salon mirror, she sits squared to it with a black cutting cape over her shoulders and her hands resting under it, the stylist's trolley and a row of chairs receding behind her reflection
cells.gaze: her eyes on her own reflection, her attention entirely inside the mirror, chin level
cells.wardrobe: a black cutting cape over an ivory silk shirt, small thin gold hoop earrings, her hair damp at the roots and combed back from the parting
cells.set: a small hairdresser's, the mirror station with warm bulbs down both sides of the glass, bottles and a comb on the shelf, the street door bright at the far end of the room
cells.light: the mirror bulbs from both sides at close range, warm and even across the front of her face, the daylight from the street door behind her cutting a cooler edge along her jaw and the top of her shoulder, the mirror glass itself returning a soft second light into the shadow side
cells.camera: 35mm at f/2.8 shooting the mirror slightly off-axis, focus on the reflected near eye
cells.notes: Заменяет «Оранжерею», где поднятая ладонь у стекла читалась приветствием на всех девяти сидах. Руки здесь под накидкой — к объективу ничего не поднимается. Влажные у корней волосы нужны: они объясняют, почему она тут.
cells.function_en: A woman in a hairdresser's chair, seen in the mirror, looking at her own reflection.
cells.alt: Chest-up reflection in a salon mirror ringed with warm bulbs, a black cutting cape over her shoulders
cells.expression: her mouth pulled to one side in doubt as she studies the reflection, eyebrows uneven

cells.label: Книжный, верхняя полка
cells.function: Кадр в рост, где рост оправдан действием: она тянется вверх, и кадр обязан быть высоким.
cells.framing: three-quarter length from the knees up, she is up on the balls of her feet with one arm reaching to a shelf just above her head and a book already in the other hand at hip height, the shelving filling the frame behind her, her head high in the upper third and large enough that her eyes read clearly
cells.gaze: her face turning down and back toward the lens over her shoulder as she reaches, eyes on the lens
cells.wardrobe: a camel wool coat open over a wine-red silk shirt and warm grey trousers, pointed-toe stiletto pumps
cells.set: a second-hand bookshop in the middle of the day, floor-to-ceiling shelves in dark wood, a rolling ladder parked two bays along, a table of stacked paperbacks at the aisle end
cells.light: daylight from the shop window at the far end of the aisle, reaching her from three-quarters front-left and falling off along the aisle behind her, the pale ceiling returning enough into the shadow side that both eyes read, the top shelf above her staying in honest shade
cells.camera: 50mm at f/4 from two steps away at chest height, focus locked on the near eye
cells.notes: Заменяет «Белый двор», который был крупным портретом без двора. ФОРМАТ 2.0, А НЕ 2.64, И ЭТО ЗАМЕР: на 2.64 фигура входила целиком, но лицо садилось до межзрачкового 96-97 px при пороге измеримости 100 — обязательные ворота резкости и кожи слепли, и все шесть кадров не отгружались. Полный рост и измеримое лицо в одном кадре у этой лоры не уживаются; выбрано лицо.
cells.function_en: A woman reaching for a book on the top shelf of a second-hand bookshop, looking back at the lens.
cells.alt: Full-length in a bookshop aisle, reaching to a high shelf with a book in her other hand, looking back over her shoulder
cells.expression: her mouth open on a word as she reads a title aloud to herself, eyebrows lifted

cells.label: Заправка ночью
cells.function: Дорога и дело в руках, перенесённые в ночь: световое пятно заправки, чёрный периметр вокруг и движение к машине.
cells.framing: full length, she is turning back from the open driver's door with one hand on the door top and her weight already moving toward the seat, the nozzle back in the pump, a paper coffee cup on the car roof, her head coming back a quarter turn to the lens, her figure filling the frame from the bottom edge into the upper third
cells.gaze: her eyes coming off the road ahead and settling on the lens a moment late
cells.wardrobe: a camel coat worn open over a deep navy sweater, flat soft leather ankle boots
cells.set: a motorway service station forecourt late at night, cold lamps under the canopy, wet asphalt holding their reflections, the black of the road beyond the light
cells.light: cold canopy lamps overhead as the general light with the open door's cabin lamp burning warm right at her face height and holding the exposure on her eyes, the wet asphalt under her returning a second pale wash up into her face, the perimeter beyond the canopy dropping to black
cells.camera: 35mm at f/4 level with her eyes, focus on her face, the lit canopy and the black road held behind her
cells.notes: Экспозиция стоит по лицу, а не по фонарям. Тёплая лампа салона на высоте лица открывает глазницы под верхним светом. Тело в движении к машине — третьей статичной стойки с весом на одной ноге набор не получает.
cells.function_en: A woman turning back from the open door of her car at a night service station, cold canopy lamps above and wet asphalt shining under her.
cells.alt: Full-length at a night petrol station, she turns back from the open car door, cold canopy lamps and wet asphalt reflections
cells._size: 2.64, а не 2:3. Замерено 19.08 на T11, лестница 1.50/1.79/2.00/2.33/2.64 по три сида: на 1.50 и 1.79 кадр всё равно поясной, фигура целиком с обувью появляется от 2.33 и уверенно на 2.64. Прежние [1024,1536] проходили линтер и не работали.
cells.expression: grimacing slightly into the cold, her chin tucked and her eyes narrowed against the wind

cells.label: Под навесом, пошёл дождь
cells.function: Погода, которой в наборе не было: она пережидает ливень и знает, что её снимают.
cells.framing: full-length under a café awning, she stands with her weight on one leg and a folded umbrella hanging from one hand, the wet pavement and the rain beyond the awning edge filling the depth behind her, her figure running from her shoes at the bottom edge to her head in the upper fifth
cells.gaze: eye contact held a beat too long, chin slightly down
cells.wardrobe: a deep navy wool coat belted at the waist over an ivory silk shirt, pointed-toe stiletto pumps, a slim gold watch catching the light
cells.set: the pavement under a café awning in a heavy afternoon shower, rain coming off the awning edge in a bright line, the street behind her running with water and the shopfronts opposite doubled in it
cells.light: flat bright overcast beyond the awning acting as a huge source from the front, the awning above her cutting the top light so her brow and eyes keep their shape with a soft shadow sitting under the brow, the wet pavement bouncing a cool second light up under her jaw
cells.camera: 35mm at f/4 from across the pavement at chest height, shutter fast enough to hold the falling drops as streaks
cells.notes: Заменяет «Танцпол», где во всех сидах был один разворот через плечо, а свет вечеринки стирал возраст — лицо выходило моложе остального набора. Навес здесь работает как флаг: он снимает верхний свет, и надбровья остаются.
cells.function_en: A woman waiting out a downpour under a café awning, a folded umbrella in her hand.
cells.alt: Full-length under a café awning in heavy rain, folded umbrella in hand, wet street behind her
cells.expression: a real grin breaking out at the absurdity of the downpour, teeth showing, eyes creased

cells.label: Крыльцо бара, вспышка
cells.function: Она вышла из шума на воздух: второй режим вспышки — улица ночью, свет берёт лицо и первый метр, дальше чёрное.
cells.framing: waist-up from one step away, she is caught mid-turn with her head arriving at three-quarters to the lens, one hand closed around her opposite forearm at waist level and a glass in the other, the porch rail crossing the lower frame
cells.gaze: her eyes reaching the lens with the lids open a moment after the flash, her, her thoughts still with the room she left
cells.wardrobe: a wine-red silk blouse under a deep navy coat slipped over her shoulders
cells.set: the porch of a neighbourhood bar late at night, a cigarette burning in an ashtray on the rail beside her, the street going away black past a few small warm windows and a red sign far down it
cells.light: direct on-camera flash from a compact camera taking her face and the first metre of the porch, a hard bright fall holding detail in the forehead and cheekbones just short of pure white, the wet asphalt below sending a little of it back up under her jaw, the night street behind her deep and dark with those few small warm lights
cells.camera: 28mm at f/4 with the flash on the lens axis, chest height, a slight tilt to the horizon, focus on her face
cells.notes: Улица ночью, а не комната: за спиной глубина и мелкие тёплые огни, мокрый асфальт возвращает часть вспышки снизу. Лоб и скулы держат деталь, глаза открыты. Крен горизонта и смещение от центра оставить — они и есть фактура мыльницы.
cells.function_en: A woman turning on the porch of a bar at night as a compact camera's flash catches her, the street behind her going black.
cells.alt: Waist-up flash photo on a bar porch at night, hard light on her face, the dark street with small warm lights behind
cells.expression: talking over her shoulder to someone behind, mid-word, her eyebrows up and her face lit hard by the flash

_replaced_19_08: Четыре клетки заменены по осмотру глазами, а не по вердикту ворот: ворота их пропустили, брак был в замысле. T13 и T17 давали крупное лицо на размытом фоне без обещанного места; T16 во всех девяти сидах поднимала ладонь к стеклу, что читается приветствием; T19 повторяла один разворот и теряла возраст на плоском свете вечеринки. Замены построены на трёх выводах: место должно быть В КАДРЕ, руку к объективу не подносить, свет держать направленным.
_full_figure: Ключ full_figure отделяет «фигуру целиком» от «фигура видна». Второе — это body_in_frame, он лишь подмешивает в промпт сложение, и кадр по колено его показывает. Высокий холст нужен только первому, и он не бесплатен: на 2.64 лицо садится ниже межзрачкового 100 px, обязательные ворота слепнут и кадр не отгружается. Книжная клетка T17 из-за этого потеряла все шесть кадров и переведена на 2.0 — выбрано лицо, а не рост.
_expression: Выражение задаётся КЛЕТКОЙ ПРЯМО, а не выводится из черты. Замер docs/variety_axes.md: из трёх осей разнообразия (выражение, причёска, план) модель слушает только первую, а четыре черты карточки описывают взгляд и подбородок, но не лицо. Пока выражения не было, двадцать кадров выходили с одним и тем же вежливым полуулыбом — именно эта одинаковость и читается как ИИ. Сильные формулировки (смех, речь на полуслове) разведены по набору, слабые (прищур, сосредоточенность) поставлены туда, где сцена их усиливает.
